## TDD Workflow

> Задачи идут Red → Green → Refactor: сначала BDD-сценарии для отсутствующего eslint, затем локальная зависимость/обёртка, затем проверка реального lint пути.

## Phase 0: BDD Foundation (Red)

- [ ] Add BDD scenarios for lint self-bootstrap -- LINTBOOT001-LINTBOOT005 — id: lintboot-01 — Status: TODO | Est: 30m
  _Requirements: [FR-1](FR.md), [FR-2](FR.md), [FR-3](FR.md), [FR-4](FR.md), [FR-5](FR.md)_
  **Done When:**
  - [ ] `lint-self-bootstrap.feature` contains one scenario per FR with matching `@FR-N` tags.
  - [ ] Scenarios describe missing eslint, existing eslint reuse, install failure reporting, plugin path review, and lockfile sync.
  - [ ] Scenarios fail before implementation because eslint is not declared/bootstrapped.

## Phase 1: Dependency and Bootstrap (Green)

  _Requirements: [FR-1](FR.md), [FR-5](FR.md)_
